fluff.overview: The Blessed Order maintained conventional infantry formations equipped with preserved Star League-era weapons and personal armor, fielding platoons that were better armed than most Successor State infantry throughout the late Succession Wars. Jump-capable platoons provide vertical mobility for urban operations and rough terrain that would slow or halt conventional foot infantry. ComStar deployed jump platoons in specialized roles where their ability to bypass obstacles justified the additional cost of jump equipment and training. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
